fix.item: Uninstalling Proclaim no longer removes the scripture library, the Scripture Links plugin, or your downloaded Bible translations. Those are shared — Scripture Links and Living Word can use the same library — and removing Proclaim was taking them away from those extensions too, along with translations that can run to hundreds of megabytes. They are now left in place, and a message after the uninstall names what remains so you can remove it yourself if you want to

Uninstalling Proclaim now removes its own modules and plugins. Nine extensions — the four Proclaim modules and the finder, Schema.org, system, task and web services plugins — stayed registered after every uninstall, along with any module positions you had set. Reinstalling then inherited them. This has been the case since 10.3.0
Uninstalling no longer reinstalls parts of Proclaim on its way out, or shows the "installation complete" page when you are removing it
Proclaim's own database tables are still kept on uninstall unless you set Drop Tables on Uninstall to Yes, which remains the default. Nothing about that has changed

Sites that installed Proclaim before 10.4.0 were checking for updates twice, and Extensions - Update listed Proclaim as a component rather than a package. The leftover update site is removed, so the duplicate entry disappears and the row reads Package. Some of those sites carried an update address that only ever served 9.2.x and could never offer them anything

A playlist sync that overlapped another one - a scheduled sync running while you started one by hand, or an impatient second click - could stop partway through with a database error, or quietly drop the rest of a media file's playlist assignments. Each video is now recorded in a single step, so the two runs agree instead of colliding

addition.item: The scripture package now installs the Scripture task and system plugins alongside the library. The task plugin downloads Bible translations in the background instead of adding around forty seconds to every install

change.item: Proclaim now bundles the CWM Scripture package as a whole rather than installing its pieces individually, so the scripture extensions are managed and updated as one unit whether you install them with Proclaim or on their own

security.item: Backup and restore only touch Proclaim's own tables. A crafted request could name any table in the database for export, and a restore file could carry statements unlike anything the backup writer produces

Image cleanup and image migration confine themselves to Proclaim's image directories. Both built delete paths from stored values without checking where they pointed, so a doctored record could remove files elsewhere on the server
Schema.org output is escaped. Text entered on a message or teacher could be carried into the structured-data block on the public page as markup
The Gemini API key is sent as a header rather than in the request URL, where it was written to any log or proxy that records addresses
The debug SQL buffer is no longer reachable by anonymous visitors, and the YouTube file cache is no longer served from a publicly readable directory
Media-file and CSV-import endpoints check permissions before acting. The media XHR route accepted any addon name and required no edit or create right; the CSV importer could be reached without one
Multi-campus location filtering can no longer be bypassed. When the filter could not resolve a user's campuses it allowed everything through instead of nothing
The delete-confirmation dialog sends a valid CSRF token again, so the warning modal is no longer silently skipped
PreachIT import validates access levels against the site's own view levels rather than trusting the imported value
The podcast download proxy routes on its configured host rather than the incoming Host header

fix.item: Admin list columns sort again. Clicking a column header submitted a name the list model did not recognise, and the click did nothing

Episode numbers are unique within a series. Two concurrent saves could allocate the same number, which podcast directories treat as one episode. Please note: where duplicates already exist, the update keeps the number on the earliest message and clears it on the others, returning them to the unnumbered state — renumber them from the episode audit screen, which reports every gap and collision

A remote playlist can only be linked once per server. Existing duplicate links are merged during the update, carrying their items and any manual media-file assignments onto the surviving playlist rather than discarding them
Teacher, topic and scripture associations are saved atomically. A failure part-way through a save could leave a message with some of its topics or references written and the rest missing
Guided tours edited in the admin are no longer overwritten on every update

Genesis verse counts are corrected. The built-in table listed 51 chapters for a 50-chapter book and held wrong counts from chapter 18 on — Genesis 24 was recorded as having 13 verses rather than 67. These figures drive the hints shown while typing a scripture reference ("Chapter 24 has 67 verses"), so those hints were wrong for most of Genesis. References were never rejected on this basis. The counts follow KJV numbering, which NKJV shares; translations that omit verses will differ, which is why the hint names KJV
Aliases generated for existing records are unique. The backfill could assign one alias to several records, and the wrong one was then served
One unreadable thumbnail no longer takes down the public podcast list
The Getting Started checklist reads the settings it is checking, so completed steps stay ticked — and the podcast step, which could never appear at all, now does
Each admin list applies its own filters. Several pages were reading the Sermons list's filter state, so filtering one screen changed the results on another
Uploaded caption files are validated in full rather than by their first lines, and files whose names contain # or ? keep their extension
The Bible version picker offers only versions the selected provider can actually serve
YouTube matching no longer mistakes a title for its reverse, log rotation failures are reported instead of being swallowed, and the rotated file is still read
Outbound requests to YouTube, Bible providers and AI services time out instead of hanging the request indefinitely
Action logging fails open: a logging error no longer aborts the operation being logged
Applying a media display setting in a batch applies the whole configuration. Writing one part of it left a combination no option on the form describes
Deleting a teacher follows Joomla's trash-then-delete flow, checks permissions, and refuses when the teacher is still in use
The series display pagination and the media file delete check no longer return a server error on every call
Podcast feeds are regenerated when podcast settings are saved
The media player switches correctly when the media type changes on the edit form
Proclaim reports its installed version from the extension manifest, so the version shown in the admin matches what is installed

JSON read and write failures are reported instead of being discarded. Corrupt stored settings previously produced empty values with no indication anything had gone wrong — including a campus mapping failure that quietly made every location unrestricted
Control panel tiles are hidden when the permission behind them is not held, and the awaiting-review count counts only content actually submitted for review
Proclaim no longer produces a fatal error when a record carries empty or corrupt saved settings, or when the component's own settings row is missing
The 9.x upgrade cleanup no longer drops a table that is still in use, and no longer runs after a failed upgrade

Updating no longer stops with a database error on a site whose sermon-topic table is missing an index the update expected to remove. Retiring that index is now cleanup that runs after the migration rather than a step that can abort it — which matters most on a database restored from a backup, where the tables and the recorded schema version can disagree

Admin form fields: corrected an inverted media-file label, stopped a template list caching one form's options into another's, escaped values in the colour picker and server-type and filter fields, and replaced classes that were unreadable in dark mode
Addon language files are spellchecked — "Protocl" had been on screen since 2022
The backup screen shows the current version rather than a stale one, and an alert type misspelled as "worning" now renders

addition.item: Episode numbers can be filled in automatically for a series, duplicates are detected as you save, and an audit report lists every gap and collision across all series
A GET /v1/proclaim/info API endpoint reporting the installed version

change.item: Analytics keeps only the scheme, host and path of a referring address. The query string is written by the referring site and routinely carries search terms, session tokens and newsletter recipient identifiers. Addresses already stored are trimmed during the update. UTM campaign tags are unaffected, being stored in their own columns. A retention setting that governed nothing has been removed

Analytics opt-out is honoured on every write. Opt-out is detected from a Sec-GPC (Global Privacy Control) header, a DNT header, or a proclaim_analytics_optout cookie your consent extension sets. Outbound link clicks recorded the destination address and time outside that check, so a visitor who had opted out was still logged; they no longer are. Proclaim ships no consent banner of its own

The analytics session identifier is a keyed digest that rotates daily, so one visitor cannot be traced across days. History written before this release held a plain unsalted hash, stable forever, and is re-keyed during the update — session counts are unchanged
Schema.org bulk sync runs in batches, and database backups stream to disk in chunks rather than being assembled in memory — both were liable to exhaust memory on large sites
Building Proclaim from source now requires Node 24; Node 20 has reached end of life. This affects contributors only, not sites running Proclaim

note.item: fix(podcast): guard the download-tracking proxy against SSRF (#1426) by @bcordis in https://github.com/Joomla-Bible-Study/Proclaim/pull/1427
Tracked episode links now carry a real file extension (e.g. .mp3),
The tracking link itself now correctly answers Range and HEAD requests —
fix(podcast): give tracked enclosure URLs a real file extension (#1424) by @bcordis in https://github.com/Joomla-Bible-Study/Proclaim/pull/1425

fix.item: Podcast feed: messages with no series attached were silently excluded from every podcast, even when correctly published and tagged for that podcast. The feed's series filter only recognized one placeholder value for "no series"; the message form saves a different one, so seriesless messages never matched and never appeared
Podcast feed: the channel link and image link are absolute. A podcast whose link is stored as a menu item gave a site-relative address, which RSS 2.0 does not allow and validators reject

Podcast feed: dates are written in the time zone set in Global Configuration, not the server's. A site configured for Chicago but hosted elsewhere published every episode date in the host's zone, and eight hours from the correct moment
Podcast feed: season and episode numbers are emitted in the form Apple reads, so episodes group into seasons in Apple Podcasts

Updating no longer reports "Could not delete folder" beside a successful update. Joomla cannot remove a cache directory the running request is using, and said so in a way that looked like the update had failed
The notice naming a cache Proclaim cannot clear no longer repeats the same plugin twice

addition.item: Podcasts have a Copyright Holder, shown as the copyright line on podcast directories. Left empty it uses the site name, so existing feeds gain a real owner in place of the previous "© (2026) All rights reserved."

Podcasts have a Feed Language covering the codes directories act on, no longer limited to the languages installed in Joomla. A US church on an en-GB Joomla install can now declare English (United States), which Apple and Spotify use for language and territory targeting

Re-detect Metadata button on the media file edit form, re-reading size, MIME type and duration from the file — for files replaced on disk under the same name, where the stored values are stale rather than missing
Re-read every file option on the Fix Missing Metadata tool, applying the same re-read in bulk. Opt-in per run: it reads every file, and on hosted platforms costs one API call per video
Clearing a detected field and saving now re-runs detection for it, so emptying the file size is enough to have it worked out again

fix.item: Podcast feed: itunes:duration is zero-padded. A single-digit seconds value was emitted bare (00:27:7), which Apple's validator rejects and several clients ignore
Podcast feed: the enclosure type is derived from the file rather than trusted from the record, and no longer defaults to the unregistered audio/mpeg3. Feeds declaring .m4a files as MP3 are corrected
Podcast feed: guid carries isPermaLink="false". RSS 2.0 defaults it to true, inviting readers to fetch the guid as a web page
Podcast feed: URLs default to https rather than http, and a root-relative podcast link no longer produces a malformed https:///path

Media durations are stored zero-padded when entered by hand. A value typed as 7 persisted as 7, and then read as "already set" to every repair and detection routine, leaving those records invisible to the tools meant to fix them
The MIME picker offered audio/mp3, which is not a registered media type and was the only MP3 option available. mp3, m4a, avi and exe now match what detection resolves
Podcast validation reports a stored MIME type that contradicts the file, and the Fix Missing Metadata tool now corrects it rather than reporting the record as already set
Sermons list: the filter panel no longer renders open on every visit, and a filter change issues one AJAX request rather than two
Media file edit: Choose Playlist(s) is hidden for server types that cannot host playlists, where it could only ever be empty

change.item: Queries are built with createQuery() throughout — 666 call sites — with a CI check to keep it that way
Caches are cleared after an update, and third-party caches Proclaim cannot clear are named so they can be cleared by hand

Release 10.3.2 — scripture provider fix, build infrastructure, and dependency upgrades by @bcordis in https://github.com/Joomla-Bible-Study/Proclaim/pull/1219

fix.item: Install failure on fresh sites — register lib_cwmscripture namespace with the autoloader before the install script's class_exists check, so the bundled scripture library is detected on first install.

note.item: Patch release for 10.3.0. Safe to install over 10.3.0; no data migration required.

addition.item: Setup Wizard — guided first-run configuration covering podcast, comments, social sharing, and core display options.
New Message Wizard — step-by-step guided sermon creation with topics, message type, access, language, and image fields.
Landing Page Redesign — three selectable layout styles (cards, hero, dashboard) with batch landing_show/list_show controls and standard Joomla ordering.
RESTful API — JSON:API endpoints with full CRUD for sermons, teachers, series, media, and podcasts; configurable access control (disabled / public / API key).
AI Writing Voice — configurable AI tone/voice options for content generation, with study text improvements.
Bible Brain Provider — new scripture/audio source integration alongside existing providers.
Interactive Transcript Panel — VTT parsing with seek-on-click and in-transcript search.
Modal Edit Support — inline edit modals for Teachers, Locations, Messages, and Servers with Quick Create toolbar.
pkg_proclaim Package Installer — bundles the component, modules, plugins, and lib_cwmscripture into a single Joomla package.
Expanded Debug Mode — new CwmDebug helper for richer troubleshooting output.
ACL Backup & Restore — component-level and per-record Proclaim ACL rules now included in backup archives.
Assets Admin Tool Rework — aligned with the new inherit-from-parent ACL model.

Edit View Polish — Publishing tabs harmonized across edit views; ID and hits visible; media Options tab renders fieldsets as labeled sections; teacher edit lazy-loads and gains an analytics time-scope.

change.item: Font Awesome upgraded to FA6 canonical syntax with FA7 forward compatibility.
AJAX filter UX improved for slow server responses; Joomla searchtools JS disabled when AJAX filters are active.
Deprecated Joomla APIs replaced with J6-native equivalents.
Popup view modernized — Flash-era dead code removed, player layout extracted.
Inline JS/CSS extracted to external files for CSP compliance; reusable layouts extracted from duplicated template blocks.
Test infrastructure now boots a real Joomla CMS framework for every test run; stubs removed.

Performance — N+1 elimination via batch loading of media files, topics, and book names; database LIMIT applied to landing page queries; loading="lazy" on embedded iframes; assets table no longer accumulates empty-rules rows; fixAllAssets skipped when nothing drifted; admin asset-fix tool batches operations.

fix.item: Teacher view — show sermons with NULL series_id and tolerate junction drift; biography editors, social_links column, and asset cleanup crash all fixed.
Teacher batch operations — accept '0' values; batch reordering no longer shuffles positions randomly.
YouTube — OAuth disconnect routed through ProclaimFetch; module cache cleared on content save; quota exhaustion from aggressive search.list polling resolved.
Analytics — KPI cards respond to date preset; platform stats task auto-registered.
Backup — virtual-table exports always emit section headers.
Install — don't clobber user-placed modules on upgrade; pkg_proclaim installer and module default params corrected.
Landing page — hero card text overflow and default image fallbacks; landing_show above/below fold respected in all layout styles; series description stripped of HTML and truncated in card meta.
Filters — series filter now clears properly when session state is stale.
Thumbnails — preserve aspect ratio and increase default sizes.
Dark mode support for the scripture autocomplete dropdown.
Calendar field — remove seconds-stripping JS that caused a flash; reset non-zero seconds to :00 on save.

security.item: Setup wizard review summary now escapes user input.
Joomla 9.x dropped from the supported-versions list.

note.item: Major feature release. Safe to install over 10.2.x; the preflight automatically reconciles schema and ACL drift.

fix.item: Missing podcast platform_links column — added in migration 10.1.0-20260303b but absent from install.mysql.utf8.sql; now included in install SQL and preflight schema check.
Preflight required-fixes pass now catches columns that should exist but were missed due to install SQL gaps, regardless of schema version.

note.item: Safe to install over 10.2.0 or 10.2.1. The preflight automatically adds the missing platform_links column if absent. No data migration required.

fix.item: Upgrade failure from duplicate column errors — fixes installation failure when upgrading between versions (e.g., 10.0.1 to 10.2.0) caused by MySQL ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN failing on columns already added by a previous partial upgrade attempt.

New preflight schema check reads install.mysql.utf8.sql to determine expected columns, compares against the live database, and drops leftover columns from failed upgrades before Joomla runs migration SQL.

note.item: Safe to install over a failed 10.2.0 upgrade — preflight cleans up automatically. Also fixes database import/restore scenarios where schema does not match expectations. No data migration required.

addition.item: Media Chapters and Subtitles — VTT/SRT caption file upload, per-media chapter timestamps, clickable chapter lists on frontend players (YouTube iframe and HTML5 video/audio).
YouTube OAuth Integration — OAuth status field, import chapters and download captions directly from YouTube, addon-aware capability flags across 7 platforms.
Per-Media Copy Description — server-configurable description format templates with placeholder replacement ({title}, {series}, {teachers}, {chapters}, etc.).
AI Assist Enhancements — chapter generation, topic saving fixes, editor API updates for Joomla 6, toggle checkboxes for selective generation.
Google Drive Server Addon — document sharing and embedding for Google Drive links.
Chunked Export/Import — async post-restore steps for large databases.
YouTube Module Improvements — countdown timer, notify button, mini-player, smart quota optimization.
Podcast Enhancements — multi-platform links with Podcast Index API, configurable iTunes settings, artwork validation.
Schema-Driven Layout Editor — settings modal driven by XML schema, media icon sizing.
Analytics Improvements — archived indicators, status filtering, drill-down views, printable reports.
Social Sharing — dual-mode sharing with GDPR-compliant local option.
Legacy URL Support — redirect old com_biblestudy URLs to com_proclaim.
Playwright E2E Tests — browser-based smoke tests for Joomla 5 and 6.

fix.item: YouTube API Quota — prevent quota exhaustion from search.list overuse; centralized file cache for throttle and scheduled start times; 15-minute search throttle saves ~200 units per hit.
AI Assist — fix topic saving (only one topic saved instead of multiple), chapter generation not displaying, deprecated Joomla editor API warnings.
Image Handling — protect source image from deletion during thumbnail cleanup; prevent File::copy error when source image is missing.
Frontend Filters — series filter not clearing due to stale session state; AJAX pagination page numbers and CSS; clear button disabled; CSRF gate removed from read-only endpoint.
SEF URLs — landing page URL fixes, session state bleeding, page caching; handle legacy 9.x SEF URLs and download redirects.
Dark Mode — theme-aware colors throughout (tables, cards, buttons, YouTube integration, analytics); WCAG AA contrast compliance.
Sermon Views — handle NULL series_id, custom not-found page with cached recent messages.
Database — correct AUTO_INCREMENT counters after backup restore; cast integer properties in Table bind() for PHP 8.3; add missing primary keys for sites upgraded from v7/v8/v9.
Analytics — correct series thumbnail column, fix Cartesian product in getSeriesList, CSV export headers.
Play Tracking — re-init YouTube players after AJAX filter, track inline mp3/Fancybox audio, use Joomla base href for multilingual sites.

security.item: Escape exception text in innerHTML to prevent XSS (CodeQL #47).

note.item: Requires PHP 8.3+ and Joomla 5.1+. Also runs on Joomla 6 without backward compatibility layer.
523 PHPUnit tests (1,149 assertions), 231 Jest tests (17 suites), PHP CS Fixer 0 issues across 373 files.

fix.item: YouTube module quota exhaustion — fixed aggressive API polling burning ~200 quota units/minute when no live stream is active. Added 15-minute search throttle, full cache TTL for null results, removed expensive search.list fallback from AJAX polling (now 1 unit per poll instead of 200).
Series filter not clearing — fixed frontend sermons page filter reverting to old selections after clearing; session state was not being reset alongside model state.
Menu item SQL error — fixed "Unknown column 'text' in order clause" when editing menu items for 8 Proclaim views; template picker SQL referenced non-existent column.
Defensive params fallback — added try/catch around menu item parameter loading so corrupted XML degrades gracefully instead of breaking the sermons page.

addition.item: Visual Layout Editor — drag-and-drop template editor with 6 configurable rows; separate layout tabs for Messages, Details, Teachers, and Series views; schema-driven settings modal; works within mod_proclaim.

Scripture Entry Redesign — replaced legacy 10-field input with natural-text autocomplete; supports unlimited references per message via new junction table, per-reference Bible versions, and drag-to-reorder.
Multi-Campus Location System — single installation serves multiple campuses with content isolation; location records map to Joomla user groups; all 11 admin list models filter by location.

Analytics Dashboard and Campus Reports — GDPR-aware event tracking (page views, plays, downloads) with Chart.js dashboard, four-level drill-down, date presets, campus filtering, CSV export, and printable pastor-ready reports.

CSV Bulk Import — import messages from CSV or spreadsheet files; client-side parsing with auto-detected delimiters, 15-field column mapping, preview table, auto-creation of teachers/series/locations, AJAX batch processing.

Bible API Provider Architecture — three providers: GetBible (free), API.Bible (2,500+ translations), Local (offline/GDPR-safe); two-level configuration with local translation management and frontend AJAX version switcher.

Image Optimization Pipeline — WebP generation, picture elements with JPEG fallback, lazy loading; admin Image Tools include batch migration, WebP conversion, orphan cleanup, and broken-reference relinking.
9.x to 10.x Migration Wizard — in-place upgrade wizard; automatic legacy schema detection, 6-step AJAX wizard with per-step retry, comprehensive data fixes, and verification.
Video platform addons — Vimeo, Wistia, Resi.io, Dailymotion, Rumble, SoundCloud, Facebook video embeds.
Schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) for rich search results.
Three pagination styles — standard, load more, infinite scroll.
Record locking (check-in/checkout) across 12 entity types.

fix.item: jQuery removal with Web Asset Manager migration.
Complete PSR-12 compliance across all PHP files.
Joomla 5/6 forward-compatible APIs throughout.

note.item: Minimum PHP 8.3.0 and Joomla 5.1.0. Runs natively on Joomla 6.
523 PHPUnit tests plus 186 Jest tests. Full details: https://github.com/Joomla-Bible-Study/Proclaim/wiki/What%27s-New-v10.1

fix.item: Fix podcastlink column missing from databases upgraded from 9.x.
Replace deprecated new JInstaller() with new Installer().
Fix Bootstrap progress bar display.
Fix error when a Series had no published studies.
Fix Simple Mode selection (#992).
Fix pagination layout at footer.
J6 compatibility changes.

change.item: Remove usage of HTMLHelper; introduce Cwmhtml.php to replace old proclaim.php helper.

addition.item: Major release — Proclaim 10.0.0 with full Joomla 4 and Joomla 5 support.

note.item: First release in the 10.x series. Upgrade from 9.2.8 via included migration tooling.

security.item: Fix XSS potential in Server Name creation. Issue discovered by Zhouyuan Yang of Fortinet FortiGuard Labs.
